title: Phase 7 controlled blind-spot validation - DET-001 v2 does not cover -Command with [Convert]::FromBase64String

controlled_command.decoded_content: plain text only: the marker SOC002-PHASE7-BLINDSPOT-TEST plus a purpose line; never executed

investigation_summary: One controlled, benign true-positive validation was executed against the Phase 6 blind spot: a PowerShell process started normally and reconstructed a harmless marker from base64 using [Convert]::FromBase64String inside a -Command script, with no encoded-command CLI switch anywhere in its command line. The existing Phase 6 detection stack was then run unmodified over the controlled window and the surrounding session. DET-001 v2 produced no candidate for the payload process, DET-002 recorded it as WinRM-delivered lineage context with 'Encoded switch = absent', and CORR-001 produced nothing for it because it iterates DET-001 candidates. The blind spot is confirmed.
observed_facts: OBSERVED: exactly one controlled execution occurred; the marker SOC002-PHASE7-BLINDSPOT-TEST was printed by PID 1428 and the process exited 0.
OBSERVED: the payload process command line is powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "... [Convert]::FromBase64String($b) ..." and contains no -EncodedCommand/-enc/-e/-en switch.
OBSERVED: Security 4688, Sysmon Event 1 and PowerShell 4104 all captured the payload process locally on WS001 (5, 5 and 4 records respectively in the controlled window).
OBSERVED: the same 14 events, with identical RecordIDs, arrived in DC1 ForwardedEvents through WEF.

OBSERVED: the process tree is winrshost.exe -> cmd.exe(/C powershell -encodedcommand) -> powershell.exe(transport) -> powershell.exe(payload), i.e. depth 3 to the payload, matching the Phase 5 controlled test.

OBSERVED: DET-001 v2 produced 1 candidate in the controlled window, all of it the transport powershell (PID 2936), which BASE-01 baselined as INFO; 0 INVESTIGATION records; 0 payload-screen escalations.
OBSERVED: the DET-001 v2 trigger returns no match when the unmodified Phase 6 library is applied to the payload's exact command line.
OBSERVED: DET-002 produced a lineage record for the payload process (PID 1428) with 'Encoded switch = absent'; CORR-001 produced no record for it.
OBSERVED: in the wider session window DET-001 v2 produced 3 INVESTIGATION records, all of them the operator's own staged-file transfers escalated by ESC-03; none is the payload process.

OBSERVED: the only network events in the controlled window are two inbound connections to WS001:5985 from the operator host and one lsass.exe connection to DC1; the payload and the transport initiated none.
OBSERVED: the first delivery attempt (a staged .ps1 executed with &) was refused by WS001's Restricted execution policy and the payload did not run; no policy was changed afterwards.
OBSERVED: Phase 5 and Phase 6 trees are byte-for-byte unchanged (88 and 34 files re-hashed and compared).
inferred_facts: INFERRED: the Phase 6 blind spot is real and reproducible - DET-001 v2's coverage is bounded by the encoded-command CLI switch, not by whether a base64 reconstruction occurred.
INFERRED: the correlation layer inherits that blind spot by construction, because CORR-001 only consumes DET-001 candidates.
INFERRED: within this lab, DET-002 is currently the only existing component that surfaces this behaviour, and only as context ('Encoded switch = absent'), not as a detection of the technique.
INFERRED: BASE-01 did not hide the Phase 7 activity; it simply never had to make a decision about it, because no candidate was created for the payload process.
not_verified: NOT VERIFIED: whether other switch-free representations of the same idea (call operator with a decoded string, Invoke-Expression, compressed/hex blobs, multi-stage decoding) are equally invisible - only the -Command + FromBase64String form was tested.
NOT VERIFIED: whether the stack would detect reconstruct-and-EXECUTE behaviour, since the decoded content in this test is plain text and is never executed.
NOT VERIFIED: the alert volume or precision of any candidate Phase 8 detection, since none was written or tested in Phase 7.
NOT VERIFIED: behaviour in any environment where WinRM is not the sanctioned management path, or at scale (one host, one run).
NOT VERIFIED: whether an attacker would use this representation at all - the test is adversary-emulation of a technique shape, not evidence of adversary intent.
classification_authority: Phase 7 lab design: one documented, benign, authorised validation run performed by the lab operator through the sanctioned WinRM management channel, with a confirmed detection gap recorded rather than hidden.

detection_result.det001_v2_detected_the_activity: NO (trigger bypassed; the payload process never became a candidate)
detection_result.det002_detected_the_activity: NO detection - it recorded CONTEXT for the payload process (lineage, 'Encoded switch = absent')
detection_result.corr001_correlated_the_activity: NO (no DET-001 candidate existed for the payload process)

analyst_conclusion: The controlled activity did exactly what the Phase 7 design required and nothing more: it decoded a fixed base64 blob to plain text and printed it. The Phase 6 detection stack was run unchanged and behaved exactly as its documentation predicted. DET-001 v2 cannot see a base64 reconstruction that is expressed inside a -Command script, because its trigger keys on the encoded-command CLI switch - this is now CONFIRMED by measurement on live activity rather than by reasoning over preserved evidence. The activity is benign, authorised lab activity and is classified as such; the finding of value is the detection gap, not the activity. No detection was modified to change the outcome.
recommended_follow_up: Phase 8 (detection engineering, NOT performed here): add a SECOND, complementary detection that keys on in-PowerShell base64 reconstruction ([Convert]::FromBase64String / FromBase64CharArray) and on decode-then-execute adjacency, rather than extending the DET-001 trigger. Keep it separate so DET-001's coverage claim stays auditable.
Phase 8: decide explicitly whether CORR-001 should be able to correlate on DET-002 lineage alone, since today anything the trigger misses is invisible to the correlation layer.
Phase 8: keep the operator's own staging traffic in view - the ESC-03 escalations caused by ordinary file transfers are a measurable precision cost that will grow with tooling use.
Do NOT broaden BASE-01 to depth-3 powershell-in-powershell; that would hide exactly the activity Phase 7 just demonstrated.
Re-run this exact controlled test unchanged after any Phase 8 detection work, so the before/after is comparable.
